brief: The 4-step funnel that turns cold traffic into recurring revenue — full diagram.

slots.title: Recurring Revenue Funnel
slots.subtitle: The 4-step system that transforms strangers into loyal subscribers.
slots.check1: Maps every stage from first click to monthly billing
slots.check2: Eliminates leaks that kill conversion and retention
slots.check3: Builds compounding income from a single traffic source

slots.title: Funnel Blueprint
slots.subtitle: One predictable path replaces random posting and inconsistent sales.
slots.check1: Aligns content, offer, and follow-up into one machine
slots.check2: Creates measurable milestones at every customer touchpoint
slots.check3: Scales profit without proportionally scaling ad spend
slots.takeawayBody: Recurring revenue requires a bridge, not just a product.

slots.title: Attract Cold Eyes
slots.subtitle: Paid or organic traffic lands on a single, focused entry point.
slots.check1: Targets one pain point to filter qualified visitors fast
slots.check2: Uses a curiosity hook that promises a specific outcome
slots.check3: Drives traffic to owned real estate, not rented platforms
slots.takeawayBody: Traffic is worthless if the entry message speaks to everyone.

slots.title: Capture Leads
slots.subtitle: Trade instant value for an email address you can nurture.
slots.check1: Lead magnet solves an urgent micro-problem in ten minutes
slots.check2: Opt-in page removes all navigation and distraction
slots.check3: Welcome sequence delivers the promise and builds trust
slots.takeawayBody: The goal is not the download; it is starting a conversation.

slots.title: Monetize Fast
slots.subtitle: Offer a low-risk paid step that proves serious intent.
slots.check1: Tripwire or core offer is priced to remove hesitation
slots.check2: Sales page handles objections before they are voiced
slots.check3: Checkout flow is frictionless with one-click upgrade options
slots.takeawayBody: First profit validates the funnel; it funds the ads.

slots.title: Recurring Revenue
slots.subtitle: Convert buyers into members with a subscription or retainer.
slots.check1: Recurring offer extends the result, not just repeats it
slots.check2: Onboarding sequence reduces first-month churn dramatically
slots.check3: Community or updates increase lifetime value over time
slots.takeawayBody: Retention is the only metric that compounds true wealth.

slots.title: Full System Map
slots.subtitle: All four stages connect into one self-reinforcing profit loop.
slots.check1: Data from retention feeds better front-end targeting
slots.check2: Profit from step three pays to acquire more cold traffic
slots.check3: Each upgrade path is engineered before launch day
slots.takeawayBody: A funnel is only finished when every stage feeds the next.

slots.body: Save this carousel and audit your current flow against these four stages. Fix one leak today.
